review_evidence: README states the target theorem: every Heyting algebra embeds into the Heyting algebra of lower sets of a partial order.
JoyalRepresentationTheorem.lean develops the spectrum/representation construction and proves embedding and injectivity lemmas.
The repository is a focused mathematical formalization by Awodey, Bauer and Carneiro, with no lossless exclusion case.
summary: Reviewed joyal; retain the formal proof of the Joyal representation theorem for Heyting algebras.
